sources.supports: OpenAI's official GPT-5 nano model documentation states cached input pricing of $0.005 per million tokens.
The documented default snapshot is dated 2025-08-07, before the models.dev price record began on 2025-08-08.

notes: OpenAI's model page gives $0.005 cached input pricing and identifies the default GPT-5 nano snapshot as 2025-08-07, so the $0.01 figure recorded by models.dev from 2025-08-08 was not the official price. The Wayback CDX query for OpenAI's pricing page returned HTTP 503; no archive bracket or more precise price-effective date was established.
